title: Power BI Developer
job_description:
Summary

Join Aperia Solutions, a leader in SaaS solutions for the Payments and Compliance industries. Aperia is a Texas-based fintech and managed consultancy firm that creates custom SaaS applications and other software-based solutions for the payments, banking, and processing industry. Founded in 1999, Aperia offers business intelligence, risk management, compliance, and customer intelligence platforms. With offices in Dallas, Washington DC, and Vietnam, Aperia is a fast-paced, global organization that strives to improve efficiency in compliance, risk, and customer service operations. Aperia's clients include banks, processors, payment facilitators, merchant service providers, independent sales organizations, and government entities. A career at Aperia promises a great challenge, culture, and opportunities to forge your own path.

Job Description

At Aperia, we rely on a dynamic team of developers. We're seeking a Power BI Developer who is ready to work with new technologies and architectures in a forward-thinking organization that's always pushing boundaries. This person will have SQL development background and Power BI development experience.

Core Responsibilities:




Meeting with key stakeholders to define data and reporting requirements
Producing and distributing daily, weekly and monthly reports to internal and external partners
Leading projects to further enhance data and reporting capabilities, including data quality and attributes and automation of manual processes
Proactively using data to generate useful insights by assessing key performance indicators & trends and presenting results to business leaders
Partnering with business and technical SMEs to understand relevant data, analyze and perform necessary deep dives to solve business problems, and summarize and present findings to management
Providing support to our business and finance stakeholders on various ongoing and ad hoc initiatives and processes.

Technical Skills

3+ years of experience in business and IT program or project management
Experience in the Financial Services and/or Payment industries
Experience in data-driven management, metrics and reporting
Strong Excel skills, including experience with macros, complex pivot tables and charts/graphs
Strong work ethic with the ability to excel in a fast-paced environment
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to build consensus
Hands on experience in Power BI and SQL
Familiarity with VBA and Python



Things that will separate you from the rest

Previous experience in Finance/Banking industry



Eligibility Requirements

Must be willing to submit to a background investigation and drug test as part of the selection process.

Job Type

3 month contract with possible extension

Schedule

Monday to Friday



This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. An employee may also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by their immediate supervisor or management. Principals only.

Recruiters please don't contact this job poster. DO NOT contact us with unsolicited services or offers.
